title: Shared Analytics Consumption Audit
methodology: Cross-referenced S800 data_sources declaration, glob enumeration of all SESSION30* JSON deliverables, scripts/s3* inventory, and REVISION_HISTORY.md entries for S301-S305

S301.purpose: Certification Readiness Framework — portfolio audit, section-level readiness, remediation categories, 26-agent exploration
deliverable_types: 4 primary governance artifacts (CERTIFICATION_READINESS_STANDARD.md, ITEM_READINESS_SCORE_SPEC.md, PORTFOLIO_RISK_REGISTER.json, CERTIFICATION_FORECAST_MODEL.json)
S301.S800_evidence: Explicitly listed in SESSION800_DASHBOARD.json data_sources (5 S301 agent files) and SESSION800_SESSION_SUMMARY.md Primary Sources

S302.purpose: Distractor Quality Score (DQS) — portfolio-wide distractor quality census (7,898 slots across 2,500 MCQ + 625 case items), DQS model v1.0
key_deliverables: SESSION302_DISTRACTOR_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json — DQS model v1.0 (5-dimension: plausibility 30%, uniqueness 20%, misconception value 20%, instructional quality 20%, discrimination 10%)
S302.S800_evidence: Explicitly listed in SESSION800_DASHBOARD.json data_sources (SESSION302_DASHBOARD.json) and SESSION800_SESSION_SUMMARY.md Primary Sources. DQS pack scores (B=85/A, C=65/C, D=63/C-, E=78/B+, Case=5/F) used in S800 §5.2.

S303.purpose: Explanation Quality Score (EQS) — portfolio-wide explanation quality census, instructional value audit, case-bank gap analysis (2,500 MCQ + 625 case items)
key_deliverables: SESSION303_EXPLANATION_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json — per-pack EQS with grade distribution (A=0, B=6, C=66, D=50, F=378 for Pack A; similar for B/C/D/E)
S303.S800_evidence: NOT listed in SESSION800_DASHBOARD.json data_sources. NOT listed in SESSION800_SESSION_SUMMARY.md Primary Sources. S800 Agent D produced independent SESSION800_EXPLANATION_QUALITY_AUDIT.json — duplicating S303 analysis.
S303.gap: S800 rebuilt explanation quality analysis instead of consuming S303 EQS model. S802 should consume SESSION303_EXPLANATION_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json and SESSION303_CASEBANK_GAP_ANALYSIS.json.

S304.purpose: Blueprint Quality Score (BQS) — blueprint coverage, weighting validation, section alignment, certification overlay, domain risk ranking across 3,125 items
key_deliverables: SESSION304_BLUEPRINT_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json — BQS model v1.0 (5-dimension: certification maturity 25%, explanation quality 25%, distractor quality 20%, metadata quality 10%, learning value 20%)
SESSION304_WEIGHTING_AUDIT.json (Domain C at 25.5% vs 20% CMA target)
S304.S800_evidence: NOT listed in SESSION800_DASHBOARD.json data_sources. NOT in S800 Primary Sources. S800 Agent H produced independent SESSION800_BLUEPRINT_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json — duplicating S304 analysis.
S304.gap: S800 rebuilt blueprint coverage matrix instead of consuming S304 BQS model. S802 should consume SESSION304_BLUEPRINT_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json and SESSION304_BLUEPRINT_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json.

S305.purpose: Exhibit Quality Score (ExQS) — exhibit realism, cognitive load, case-bank feedback gap audit (120 cases, 625 items, 117 exhibits), learning friction register
key_deliverables: SESSION305_EXHIBIT_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json — ExQS model v1.0 (5-dimension: realism 25%, usability 25%, instructional support 20%, cognitive efficiency 15%, business relevance 15%)
S305.S800_evidence: NOT listed in SESSION800_DASHBOARD.json data_sources. NOT in S800 Primary Sources. S800 §6 covers defect status but does not consume the ExQS model or cognitive load audit.
S305.gap: S800 did not consume S305 exhibit quality or cognitive load data. S802 should consume SESSION305_EXHIBIT_QUALITY_SCORE_MODEL.json, SESSION305_COGNITIVE_LOAD_AUDIT.json, and SESSION305_LEARNING_FRICTION_REGISTER.json.

s800_rebuilt_analytics.explanation_quality: S800 Agent D produced SESSION800_EXPLANATION_QUALITY_AUDIT.json — S303 already has EQS model + 11 deliverables
s800_rebuilt_analytics.distractor_quality: S800 Agent E produced SESSION800_DISTRACTOR_QUALITY_CENSUS.json — S302 DQS model was consumed (partial), but S800 rebuilt the census
s800_rebuilt_analytics.blueprint_coverage: S800 Agent H produced SESSION800_BLUEPRINT_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json — S304 already has BQS model + coverage matrix + weighting audit
s800_rebuilt_analytics.exhibit_quality: S800 has no exhibit quality audit — S305 ExQS model and cognitive load audit were not consumed or rebuilt

compliance.s802_consumption_recommendation: S802 should consume S303 EQS, S304 BQS, and S305 ExQS directly rather than re-scanning pack/case files. The model JSON files, census data, and domain-level scores already exist. The scripts (s303_explanation_analysis.js, s304_blueprint_analysis.js, s305_exhibit_analysis.js) can be reused if fresh computation is needed, but the JSON deliverables are the primary consumption target.
gaps: S800 consumed only S301 and S302 — not S303, S304, or S305
S800 rebuilt explanation quality audit (Agent D) — S303 EQS existed
S800 rebuilt blueprint coverage matrix (Agent H) — S304 BQS existed
S800 has no exhibit quality analysis — S305 ExQS exists but was not consumed
No s302 analysis script found in scripts/ — S302 analysis was agent-inline only
Timing issue: S301-S305 and S800 all executed 2026-07-26 — S303/S304/S305 may have been in-flight during S800 launch
compliance.verdict: ALL_FIVE_ANALYTICS_EXIST_AND_CAN_BE_CONSUMED — S302 DQS and S301 were consumed by S800. S303 EQS, S304 BQS, and S305 ExQS were NOT consumed by S800. S802 must consume these 3 existing analytics rather than rebuilding. The score model JSONs, census JSONs, and domain-level dashboards are all present and structurally complete.
